newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Russia's Yeltsin arrives in Ukraine for visit.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Yeltsin arrives in Ukraine for visit.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin arrived in Ukraine on Friday at the start of a visit aimed at improving troubled relations through a friendship and cooperation treaty.
Reporters saw Yeltsin's plane arrive shortly before 4 p.m. (1300 GMT). He was due to meet Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma later for talks and a ceremonial dinner.
The leaders of the two former Soviet republics are due to sign a treaty on Saturday at 11.30 a.m. (0830 GMT).

"(It is) the most difficult visit and the most important foreign policy act by the Russian President in 1997," Yeltsin's spokesman Sergei Yastrzhembsky was quoted by Russia's Interfax news agency as saying before Yeltsin's departure from Moscow.
